Cap and trade is lowering emissions globally

A market-based approach like cap and trade allows countries to make more ambitious climate goals. Contractors at build site. Environmental enforcement officials, trained by EDF, conduct an on-site inspection at a factory in China.

in 2017 with help from EDF. The new emissions trading system is expected to be the world’s largest, dwarfing all existing programs, and is a central component of China’s strategy to tackle climate pollution. The national program builds on pilot emissions trading systems, which have included elements of cap and trade and are already underway in seven cities and provinces in China. They cover more than 2,600 companies in regions with a population of more than 258 million.
